queue.hypothesis: Increase n_head from 4 to 8 to improve multi-head parallelism for key-value binding
queue.rationale: With state_size at 64 and n_head at 4, each head has 16 dimensions. Increasing to 8 heads with 8 dimensions each may improve the model's ability to learn diverse key-value associations through more parallel attention pathways.
queue.instruction: Change n_head from 4 to 8 in experiment_config.yaml
